data.one_liner: Numeric input widget with a text field and spin buttons for quick adjustments
data.what_it_does: Provides Material and Cupertino numeric input widgets combining an input field with quick-adjustment spin buttons. Supports large value ranges, high precision, and custom behaviors via callbacks like onChanged and onSubmitted.
use_when: You need numeric inputs with both direct text entry and increment/decrement buttons
Sliders are too inaccurate and plain text fields are inconvenient for quick value changes
You need both Material and Cupertino style numeric spin boxes
avoid_when: You only need a standard text form field without increment buttons
You are looking for non-numeric pickers or date pickers
strengths: Supports both Material and Cupertino designs out of the box
Provides range limits, step values, and formatting options
Includes helpful callbacks for validation and submission
data.minimal_example:
SpinBox(
  min: 1,
  max: 100,
  value: 50,
  onChanged: (value) => print(value),
)
